title: Taiseel's next 12-month business focus
decision: Choose the business model and market wedge Taiseel should prioritise for the next 12 months.

options.label: Build one paid Land Intelligence product
Stop or pivot away from Taiseel

brief: Taiseel combines a Rwanda-first real-estate intelligence and exchange vision with a separate-looking development/JV proposition. The reviewed material does not establish paying customers, revenue or delivery economics. The council must test demand, not reward the amount of software built.
assumptions: Revenue and paying-customer count are unknown, not assumed to be zero.
Founder-led and resource-constrained delivery is assumed until team, hours and runway are verified.
No repeatable paid demand has been evidenced in the reviewed project materials.
The 120+ completed-projects claim on the Taiseel Development website is unverified.
